series.name: CP850/1000/1350/1500AVRLCD (Intelligent UPS, AVR, line-interactive 850-1500VA)
series.notes: Same E-prefix fault namespace and identical E01/E02/E11/E21/E22 wording as SERIES 1, kept as a separate block because CyberPower publishes a separate manual per family and the icon set differs (NORMAL/AVR/SILENT MODE instead of ONLINE/ENERGY-SAVING/MUTE). Also covers the red 'Wiring Fault Indicator' on the rear, which is a separate hardware alarm, not an E-code.

title.ur: E01 Charger Fault - Overcharge (charger battery ko zyada charge kar raha)

meaning.en: The charger is overcharging the internal battery bank, so the UPS latches a fault on the LCD FAULT icon.
meaning.ur: Charger internal battery bank ko zyada charge kar raha hai, is liye UPS LCD FAULT icon par fault lock kar leta hai.

causes.en: Charger over-voltage sensing circuit or the charge IC has failed.
causes.ur: Charger over-voltage sensing circuit ya charge IC kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Aged, overheated or swollen battery bank drags the charger into overcharge.
causes.ur: Purani, garmi se kharab ya phooli hui battery bank charger ko overcharge mein kheench leti hai.

causes.en: Incorrect high-voltage replacement battery installed in a lower-rated string.
causes.ur: Kam rating wali string mein galat high-voltage replacement battery lagayi gayi hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off, unplug the mains cord and pull the internal battery quick-connect before opening the case.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, mains cord nikaal dein aur case kholne se pehle internal battery quick-connect nikaal lein.

solutions.en: Measure each battery on DC volts with a multimeter; a healthy 12V cell reads 12.6-13.0V and should stay under about 13.8V.
solutions.ur: Multimeter DC volt par har battery measure karein; healthy 12V cell 12.6-13.0V par hota hai aur 13.8V se kam rehna chahiye.

solutions.en: Swap the whole battery bank for the CyberPower-specified replacement, keeping matched cells in series.
solutions.ur: Poori battery bank ko CyberPower ki spec wali replacement se badal dein, series mein cells jor ke rakhein.

solutions.en: If readings are normal, treat the charger board as failed and raise it with CyberPower Systems support.
solutions.ur: Agar readings normal hain to charger board ko kharab samajhein aur CyberPower Systems support se baat karein.

source.title: Intelligent UPS Series CP850/1000/1350/1500AVRLCD User Manual

title.ur: E02 Charger Fault - No Charge (charger battery charge hi nahi kar raha)

meaning.en: The charger is not putting charge into the battery bank, so the UPS reports a fault and has no battery reserve.
meaning.ur: Charger battery bank mein charge nahi daal raha, is liye UPS fault report karta hai aur us ke paas battery reserve nahi hota.

causes.en: Internal battery connector is unplugged or the terminal clamp is loose/corroded.
causes.ur: Internal battery connector nikaala hua hai ya terminal clamp dheela/zanga hai.

causes.en: Battery bank is dead (0V on DC) or has one failed cell in series.
causes.ur: Battery bank poori tarah dead (DC par 0V) hai ya series mein ek cell kharab hai.

causes.en: Fuse in the battery branch, or the charger MOSFET/PWM section, has failed open.
causes.ur: Battery branch ka fuse, ya charger MOSFET/PWM section, open ho kar kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the unit first: off, unplug mains, disconnect the internal battery quick-connect.
solutions.ur: Pehle unit isolate karein: off karein, mains nikaal dein, internal battery quick-connect disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Check battery DC voltage; a rested healthy 12V battery reads 12.4-12.7V, near 0V means it must be replaced.
solutions.ur: Battery ka DC voltage check karein; aaram wali healthy 12V battery 12.4-12.7V par hoti hai, 0V ke qareeb ho to badalni hai.

solutions.en: With mains reconnected, measure the charge voltage at the battery terminals; about 13.5-14V is healthy, near 0V points to a blown fuse or failed charger.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas lagane ke baad battery terminals par charge voltage measure karein; 13.5-14V healthy hai, 0V ke qareeb ho to fuse ya charger kharab hai.

solutions.en: Replace a dead pack with the specified battery; if E02 stays with a new pack, escalate the charger board.
solutions.ur: Dead pack ko spec wali battery se badal dein; nayi pack par bhi E02 rahe to charger board support ko bhejein.

source.title: Intelligent UPS Series CP850/1000/1350/1500AVRLCD User Manual

title.ur: E11 Battery Overvoltage (battery ka voltage safe limit se upar)

meaning.en: Battery voltage has risen above the safe threshold and the UPS has cut inverter drive to protect the cells.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage safe threshold se upar chali gayi hai aur UPS ne cells bachane ke liye inverter drive band kar diya hai.

causes.en: Over-voltage protection relay or sensing line has failed so charging is never cut.
causes.ur: Over-voltage protection relay ya sensing line kharab ho gayi hai is liye charging kabhi band nahi hoti.

causes.en: An extra cell in series has pushed the string above the charger set-point.
causes.ur: Series mein ek extra cell lag gaya hai jis se string charger set-point se upar chali gayi.

causes.en: Swollen, internally shorted battery absorbing charge without taking it.
causes.ur: Phooli hui aur andar se short battery charge le rahi hai lekin use nahi kar rahi.

solutions.en: Turn off, unplug mains and disconnect the battery before any measurement.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi measurement se pehle off karein, mains nikaal dein aur battery disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Count the cells in series and confirm they match the model's specified battery configuration.
solutions.ur: Series mein cells gin lein aur confirm karein ke woh model ki battery configuration se match karte hain.

solutions.en: Measure each cell on DC range; above about 13.8V at rest means replace that battery and its pair together.
solutions.ur: Har cell ko DC range par measure karein; aaram karte waqt 13.8V se upar ho to us battery ko aur us ki jodi ko saath badal dein.

solutions.en: If voltage is in range but E11 still shows, it is a sensing/relay failure - route the unit to CyberPower Systems support.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage range mein ho phir bhi E11 aaye to sensing/relay failure hai - unit CyberPower Systems support ko bhejein.

source.title: Intelligent UPS Series CP850/1000/1350/1500AVRLCD User Manual

title.ur: E21 Battery Output Short Fault (battery mode mein output short)

meaning.en: The UPS output is shorted while running on battery. The FAULT icon latches and stays on until the short is cleared and the unit is switched back on.
meaning.ur: Battery par chalte waqt UPS output short ho gaya hai. FAULT icon lock ho jata hai aur short hataye baghair on karne tak nahi jaata.

causes.en: A connected device has failed with a short circuit (PSU, monitor, motor, compressor).
causes.ur: Koi connected device short circuit ke saath kharab ho gaya hai (PSU, monitor, motor, compressor).

causes.en: A power strip or extension lead has a cut or crushed live core.
causes.ur: Power strip ya extension wire ka koi live core kata ya daba hua hai.

causes.en: Outlet terminals on the UPS board are loose/bridged, or the battery cable is chafed to the chassis.
causes.ur: UPS board par outlet terminals dheele hain ya bridge hue hain, ya battery cable chassis se ghis gaya hai.

solutions.en: Switch off, unplug mains and disconnect the battery, then unplug every load from all UPS outlets.
solutions.ur: Off karein, mains aur battery disconnect karein, phir tamam UPS outlets se saara load nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Reconnect one device at a time; the unit that trips E21 again is the short, so isolate and repair it.
solutions.ur: Ek-ek device wapas lagayein; jis par dobara E21 aaye wohi short hai, use alag karke repair karwayein.

solutions.en: With the unit isolated, use a multimeter on continuity/ohms from each outlet to neutral; near-zero ohms confirms the short path.
solutions.ur: Unit isolate karne ke baad multimeter continuity/ohms par har outlet ko neutral se check karein; zero ke qareeb ohms short path confirm karte hain.

solutions.en: If every outlet measures clean and E21 still returns, the inverter output stage is faulty - send to CyberPower Systems support.
solutions.ur: Agar har outlet clean nikle phir bhi E21 aaye to inverter output stage kharab hai - CyberPower Systems support ko bhejein.

source.title: Intelligent UPS Series CP850/1000/1350/1500AVRLCD User Manual

title.en: E22 Battery or AC Mode Overload Fault
title.ur: E22 Battery ya AC Mode Overload Fault

meaning.en: Output load exceeds the UPS rating in battery mode or on AC/utility power, and the UPS cuts out to protect itself.
meaning.ur: Battery mode ya AC/utility power par output load UPS ki rating se zyada hai aur UPS apni protection ke liye output band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Total connected wattage exceeds the unit rating (e.g. over 1000W on CP1500AVRLCD).
causes.ur: Total connected wattage unit ki rating se zyada hai (jaise CP1500AVRLCD par 1000W se upar).

causes.en: High inrush from a compressor, laser printer or motor when mains returns.
causes.ur: Mains wapas aate hi compressor, laser printer ya motor ka high inrush ho raha hai.

causes.en: An undersized power strip feeding the load from the UPS outlets.
causes.ur: UPS outlets se load le kar chal raha kam rating wala power strip.

solutions.en: Switch off and unplug, then unplug at least one piece of equipment from the battery outlets and turn the UPS on again.
solutions.ur: Off karke plug nikaal dein, phir battery outlets se kam az kam ek equipment nikaal dein aur UPS dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Add devices back one by one and total their watts; keep the sum inside the unit's rated watts for the battery outlets.
solutions.ur: Devices ek-ek karke wapas lagayein aur watt total karein; battery outlets ke liye total unit ki rated watts se andar rakhein.

solutions.en: Confirm the rear circuit breaker is fully pushed in and that no outlet is being fed past its own surge rating.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke rear circuit breaker poori tarah andar hai aur koi outlet apni surge rating se upar feed nahi ho raha.

solutions.en: If a large inrush appliance must stay connected, reconnect it after everything else so the UPS is not switching it on by itself.
solutions.ur: Agar bade inrush wala appliance lagna hi hai, use sab kuch connect hone ke baad wapas lagayein taake UPS use khud on na kare.

source.title: Intelligent UPS Series CP850/1000/1350/1500AVRLCD User Manual

title.ur: NORMAL icon (sab kuch theek, mains par kaam kar raha hai)

meaning.en: Status icon confirming the UPS is working under normal conditions on utility power. No action needed.
meaning.ur: Status icon jo confirm karta hai ke UPS normal conditions mein utility power par kaam kar raha hai. Koi action zaruri nahi.

causes.en: Utility power is present and within range; the inverter is in bypass/online pass-through.
causes.ur: Mains maujood aur range mein hai; inverter bypass/online pass-through mein hai.

solutions.en: No action required - this is the healthy state; leave the unit on so the battery stays charged.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaruri nahi - yeh healthy state hai; unit on chhor dein taake battery charged rahe.

solutions.en: Use the LCD INPUT voltage meter occasionally to check supply quality, especially if the area has frequent voltage swings.
solutions.ur: Agar ilaqa mein voltage baar baar udalta hai to kabhi kabhi LCD INPUT voltage meter se supply quality check kar lein.

source.title: Intelligent UPS Series CP850/1000/1350/1500AVRLCD User Manual

title.ur: BATTERY icon (abhi internal battery se chal raha hai)

meaning.en: Status icon shown during sustained under-voltage or power loss: the UPS is feeding the load from its internal batteries. A steady continuous alarm warns the battery is nearly out.
meaning.ur: Status icon jo sustained under-voltage ya power loss dikhata hai: UPS load ko internal battery se feed kar raha hai. Mukhtalif alarm ka matlab hai ke battery khatam hone wali hai.

causes.en: Mains power failed or the input voltage fell below the transfer threshold.
causes.ur: Mains chali gayi ya input voltage transfer threshold se neeche gir gaya.

causes.en: The on/off switch was switched too quickly and the unit is protecting its own control circuit.
causes.ur: On/off switch bahut jaldi daba diya gaya aur unit apna control circuit protect kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Save files and turn off your equipment, or let the software perform a controlled shutdown.
solutions.ur: Files save karein aur apna equipment band karein, ya software se controlled shutdown karwayein.

solutions.en: After mains returns, leave the UPS plugged in for a full recharge (typically 8 hours from total discharge under 100% load).
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane ke baad UPS ko plug mein chhor dein poori recharge ke liye (100% load par total discharge se aam tor par 8 ghante).

source.title: Intelligent UPS Series CP850/1000/1350/1500AVRLCD User Manual

title.ur: OVER LOAD icon (outlets par load zyada hai)

meaning.en: Status icon with an alarm indicating the battery-supplied outlets are overloaded; it clears as you unplug equipment.
meaning.ur: Status icon jo alarm ke saath batata hai ke battery-supplied outlets overloaded hain; equipment nikalte hi yeh clear ho jata hai.

causes.en: Plugged devices together draw more than the UPS battery-outlet rating.
causes.ur: Lagaye gaye devices mil kar UPS battery outlet rating se zyada lete hain.

causes.en: A surge or motor inrush from a newly connected device.
causes.ur: Naye device se power surge ya motor inrush aaya hai.

solutions.en: Unplug equipment one piece at a time from the battery-supplied outlets until the icon turns off and the alarm stops.
solutions.ur: Battery-supplied outlets se ek-ek karke equipment nikaalte jayein jab tak icon band na ho aur alarm na ruke.

solutions.en: Confirm remaining draw on a power meter and push the rear circuit-breaker knob fully in.
solutions.ur: Power meter se bacha hua draw confirm karein aur rear circuit-breaker knob poori tarah andar push karein.

source.title: Intelligent UPS Series CP850/1000/1350/1500AVRLCD User Manual

title.ur: Peeche Wiring Fault Indicator (red) jal raha hai

meaning.en: A separate red LED on the rear warns that the wall outlet wiring is bad - bad ground, missing ground or reversed wiring - so surge protection is unavailable.
meaning.ur: Peeche ka alag red LED warn karta hai ke wall outlet wiring kharab hai - beech ground, missing ground ya reversed wiring - is liye surge protection kaam nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Wall outlet has no earth/ground connection or the earth wire is loose.
causes.ur: Wall outlet mein earth/ground connection nahi hai ya earth wire dheeli hai.

causes.en: Live and neutral are reversed in the socket or in the supply wiring.
causes.ur: Socket ya supply wiring mein live aur neutral aapas mein ulat gaye hain.

solutions.en: Unplug the UPS from the outlet first and do not touch the socket with the UPS connected.
solutions.ur: Pehle UPS ko outlet se nikaal dein aur UPS lagi hui halat mein socket ko haath na lagayein.

solutions.en: Test the outlet with an outlet tester pen or a multimeter for live-neutral-earth continuity; earth should show continuity to the building ground.
solutions.ur: Outlet ko tester pen ya multimeter se check karein live-neutral-earth continuity ke liye; earth ki building ground se continuity honi chahiye.

solutions.en: Have a qualified electrician re-terminate the socket and restore proper grounding - do not DIY the mains wiring.
solutions.ur: Kaamayeda electrician se socket dobara terminate karwayein aur proper earth dein - mains wiring khud mat karein.

source.title: Intelligent UPS Series CP850/1000/1350/1500AVRLCD User Manual
